name: How long does a typical basement door installation take?

mainEntity.name: How long does a typical basement door installation take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of a basement door installation varies depending on the door type and complexity of the project. A standard bulkhead door replacement might take 1-2 days, assuming the existing opening is suitable. If a new opening needs to be created or structural modifications are required for a standard exterior door, the project could extend to 3-5 days. This includes preparation, installation, sealing, and any necessary finishing work.
acceptedAnswer.description: Installation time varies: 1-2 days for simple replacements, 3-5 days for new openings or structural modifications.
